name: Greip
desc: Detect and prevent fraud in your website or app with Greip's Fraud Prevention API. Protect your business from financial losses and gain better insights into your users.

actions.name: email_validation
actions.description: Validate email addresses by checking domain validity, detecting disposable emails, and assessing risk factors

actions.name: profanity_detection

actions.name: phone_validation
actions.description: Validate phone numbers by checking syntax and assessing validity and operational status
